usageNotes: Use this to atomically set or unset one or more Ceph cluster-wide feature flags (e.g. suspending backfill, scrubbing, or rebalancing) in a single call; omitted flags are left unchanged. Requires Sys.Modify on / (root). The operation runs as a worker task and returns a UPID — poll the task status if you need to confirm completion before proceeding.

examples.summary: Suspend backfill and rebalancing during a planned OSD maintenance window, then re-enable them after

tips: Flags like 'noout' and 'norebalance' are commonly paired during OSD replacement to prevent premature data movement.
Setting 'pause' halts all Ceph reads and writes cluster-wide — use only in a controlled, coordinated maintenance window.
After maintenance, call this endpoint again with the same flags set to false to restore normal cluster behavior; do not rely on Proxmox to auto-clear them.
Check current flag state with get_cluster_ceph_flags before writing to avoid accidentally clearing flags set by another operator.
